Name: Michal
Role: Daughter of Saul; Wife of David
Summary: Michal, Saul's younger daughter, loved David and married him, then saved his life by letting him down through a window when Saul sent men to kill him. Saul later gave her to Palti, and David took her back when he became king. She despised David's dancing before the ark and remained childless.
KeyStory: Michal loved David, saved him from her father's assassins, and later scorned his worship before the ark.
KeyVerses: 1 Samuel 14:49; 1 Samuel 18:20; 1 Samuel 19:11; 1 Samuel 19:12; 2 Samuel 3:13; 2 Samuel 6:16; 2 Samuel 6:23
RelatedPeople: King Saul; King David; Merab; Phalti, Son of Laish
LifeLesson: Love, loyalty, and later contempt can live in one heart — and worship scorned has its own cost.
